responsibility: Defines the DFA scheduling model for the IBM PowerPC 476 processor. It describes the 476 issue structure and execution pipelines, including separate core and floating-point issue resources, and assigns reservation/latency data for integer, compare, load/store, branch, multiply/divide, CR, and FP instruction classes so GCC can schedule RTL for cpu=ppc476 accurately.
same_name_distinction: This is the 476 machine-description scheduling file: it defines automata, cpu units, and instruction reservations for cpu=ppc476. Unlike 476.h, it does not override target macros, and unlike 476.opt, it does not register command-line options.
